title: Shape tween: colorEffect not interpolated between keyframes
description: In timeline-query.ts (line 314), interpolateShapeTween is called for shape tweens but the caller never interpolates colorEffect. For motion tweens, colorEffect interpolation happens (line 285). Fix: after calling interpolateShapeTween, also interpolate the colorEffect between the start and end keyframe's displayObjects using the same lerp logic used for motion tweens. The resulting interpolated colorEffect should be applied to each display object returned by interpolateShapeTween.
